title: One hand-built combined PR merges the express heads in order, built by a lane off main
why: Many express lanes each cost a PR run and a main run; the owner allows a combined PR that saves CI, and nothing builds one yet.
source: Coordinator 15:44 CST Nov 13; ruling own-767-a-combined-pr; text rules in step claude-md-merge-alone-or-combined.
note: Filed 15:45 CST Nov 13. One hand-built PR merges the express heads in order, built by a lane off main, under the recipe of step combined-pr-recipe (lane lint, ready, its own record; the runner merges it alone on its own green run; a red one drops a lane).
